acquisition method: All data were acquired with the mass spectrometer operating in an automatic dependent switching mode.
alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 0.55 m iodoacetamide at room temperature
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 0.55 m iodoacetamide at room temperature
cleavage agent: Sequence Grade Trypsin (Promega) (0.5 μg/μl) was added to the proteins
instrument: loaded onto a QExactive (ThermoFisher Scientific) high-resolution accurate mass spectrometer
ionization type: on a 50 cm EASY-Spray PepMap C18 column
labeling: The molecular mechanisms promoting bacterial growth were investigated using label-free quantitative (LFQ) proteomics
reduction reagent: The protein sample was reduced by adding 1 μl 0.5 m dithiothreitol (DTT)
reduction concentration: The protein sample was reduced by adding 1 μl 0.5 m dithiothreitol (DTT)
